title: ITVX / Laptop landing page
slide_intent: Carry campaign recognition into the first streaming-service screen, because viewers need to recognize the same service across different situations.
strategic_value: This approach can strengthen continuity between campaign recognition and service use.
demonstration: A laptop on a bright yellow field displays talent portrait columns, a central ITVX logo and small supporting copy.
practical_value: Carry campaign recognition into the first streaming-service screen.

content_islands.name: Laptop screen
content_islands.spec: Talent strips converge around the central logo and offer.

reference_purposes.Expression: A laptop on a bright yellow field displays talent portrait columns, a central ITVX logo and small supporting copy.
reference_purposes.Application: Carry campaign recognition into the first streaming-service screen. Evidence is the shown application, not a mandatory layout rule.
